description: This file defines the LocalizedDateFormatter class, which provides functionality for formatting DateTime objects with support for localization of day and month names. It uses helper traits for text manipulation and internationalization, and includes constants and methods for handling different date format characters, localizing day and month names, and caching formatted results.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatter
classes.description: A helper class for formatting dates according to locale-specific names for days and months, with caching and customizable formats.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string based on the specified date format, applying localization replacements for day and month names.

methods.name: getSearchAndReplaceParams
methods.description: Returns cached or new search and replace arrays for localizing parts of the date string based on the date format.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortDays
methods.description: Adds short day names and their translations to search and replace arrays if the format string contains the relevant character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongDays
methods.description: Adds long day names and their translations to search and replace arrays if the format string contains the relevant character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortMonth
methods.description: Adds short month names and their translations to search and replace arrays if the format string contains the relevant character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongMonth
methods.description: Adds long month names and their translations to search and replace arrays if the format string contains the relevant character.
